propositions: The review bot computes per-call token usage (_input_tokens, _output_tokens, _cache_read_tokens, _cache_write_tokens) in runner.py but discards it after attaching to result[_usage], leaving no retrievable token metrics.
Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide agent steps expose _usage on their outputs in finalize.py, but the code-review metrics assembler reads only the request count, not token fields.
The bot publishes CloudWatch error counts via boto3 best-effort pattern in voter.py but has no wiring to emit token counts alongside those errors.
_attach_code_review_metrics must aggregate token fields across all _usage-bearing succeeded steps and store sums (input/output/cache_read/cache_write/total) in coverage.metrics.

_publish_token_usage_metrics must emit five review_bot_llm_*_tokens metrics to CloudWatch Namespace=rebar/host with Unit=Count, swallowing boto3 import/credential errors per the existing fail-open contract.
Pass-1 finder batch does not surface per-finder _usage on step output, deferring complete token visibility to a linked follow-up ticket while unblocking agent-step token capture now.
